ayahs.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلطُّورِ
ayahs.en: By the mount
ayahs.tr: Wat-Toor

ayahs.ar: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
ayahs.en: And [by] a Book inscribed
ayahs.tr: Wa kitaabim mastoor

ayahs.ar: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
ayahs.en: In parchment spread open
ayahs.tr: Fee raqqim manshoor

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
ayahs.en: And [by] the frequented House
ayahs.tr: Wal baitil ma'moor

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
ayahs.en: And [by] the heaven raised high
ayahs.tr: Wassaqfil marfoo'

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
ayahs.en: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
ayahs.tr: Wal bahril masjoor

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
ayahs.en: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
ayahs.tr: Inna 'azaaba Rabbika lawaaqi'

ayahs.ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
ayahs.en: Of it there is no preventer.
ayahs.tr: Maa lahoo min daafi'

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
ayahs.en: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
ayahs.tr: Yawma tamoorus samaaa'u mawraa

ayahs.ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
ayahs.en: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
ayahs.tr: Wa taseerul jibaalu sairaa

ayahs.ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.en: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
ayahs.tr: Fawailuny yawma 'izil lil mukaazzibeen

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.en: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
ayahs.tr: Allazeena hum fee khawdiny yal'aboon

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahs.en: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
ayahs.tr: Yawma yuda'-'oona ilaa naari jahannama da'-'aa

ayahs.ar: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.en: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
ayahs.tr: Haazihin naarul latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon

ayahs.ar: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.en: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
ayahs.tr: Afasihrun haazaaaa am antum laa tubsiroon

ayahs.ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.en: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
ayahs.tr: Islawhaa fasbirooo aw laa tasbiroo sawaaa'un 'alaikum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
ayahs.tr: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa na'eem

ayahs.ar: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.en: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
ayahs.tr: Faakiheena bimaaa aataahum rabbuhum wa waqaahum rabbuhum 'azaabal jaheem

ayahs.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
ayahs.tr: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
ayahs.en: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
ayahs.tr: Muttaki'eena 'alaa sururim masfoofatinw wa zawwaj naahum bihoorin 'een

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
ayahs.en: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena aamanoo wattaba'at hum zurriyyatuhum bieemaanin alhaqnaa bihim zurriyyatahum wa maaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shai'; kullum ri'im bimaa kasaba raheen

ayahs.ar: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.en: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
ayahs.tr: Wa amdadnaahum bifaa kihatinw wa lahmim mimmaa yashtahoon

ayahs.ar: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
ayahs.en: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
ayahs.tr: Yatanaaza'oona feehaa kaasal laa laghwun feehaa wa laa taaseem

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.en: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
ayahs.tr: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim ghilmaanul lahum ka annahum lu'lu'um maknoon

ayahs.ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
ayahs.tr: Wa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'diny yatasaaa'aloon

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].
ayahs.tr: Qaalooo innaa kunnaa qablu feee ahlinaa mushfiqeen

ayahs.ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.en: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
ayahs.tr: Famannnal laahu 'alainaa wa waqaanaa 'azaabas samoom

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.en: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
ayahs.tr: Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahoo huwal barrur raheem

ayahs.ar: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
ayahs.en: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
ayahs.tr: Fazakkir famaaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahininw wa laa majnoon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
ayahs.en: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
ayahs.tr: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raibal manoon

ayahs.ar: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
ayahs.en: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
ayahs.tr: Qul tarabbasoo fa innee ma'akum minal mutarabbiseen

ayahs.ar: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
ayahs.tr: Am taamuruhum ahlaamuhum bihaazaaa am hum qawmun taaghoon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
ayahs.tr: Am yaqooloona taqawwalah; bal laa yu'minoon

ayahs.ar: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.en: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
ayahs.tr: Falyaatoo bihadeesim misliheee in kaanoo saadiqeen

ayahs.ar: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.en: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
ayahs.tr: Am khuliqoo min ghairi shai'in am humul khaaliqoon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
ayahs.tr: Am khalaqus samaawaati wal ard; bal laa yooqinoon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
ayahs.en: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
ayahs.tr: Am'indahum khazaaa'inu rabbika am humul musaitiroon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.en: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
ayahs.tr: Am lahum sullamuny yastami'oona feehi falyaati mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
ayahs.en: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
ayahs.tr: Am lahul banaatu wa lakumul banoon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
ayahs.tr: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
ayahs.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
ayahs.tr: Am 'indahumul ghaibu fahum yaktuboon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
ayahs.en: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
ayahs.tr: Am yureedoona kaidan fallazeena kafaroo humul makeedoon

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.en: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
ayahs.tr: Am lahum ilaahun ghairul laa; subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon

ayahs.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
ayahs.en: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
ayahs.tr: Wa iny yaraw kisfam minas samaaa'i saaqitany yaqooloo sahaabum markoom

ayahs.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
ayahs.en: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
ayahs.tr: Fazarhum hatta yulaaqoo yawmahumul lazee feehi yus'aqoon

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.en: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
ayahs.tr: Yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kaidumhum shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.tr: Wa inna lillazeena zalamoo 'azaaban doona zalika wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.en: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
ayahs.tr: Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa innaka bi-a'yuninaa wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.en: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
ayahs.tr: Wa minal laili fasabbihhu wa idbaaran nujoom
